description: A file's version history, not per-line blame (that is blame): the commits that changed it on a commit's history (git log <rev> -- <path>), newest first: sha, commit_id, author, date, summary, status (added/modified/deleted). Renames not followed. has_more: older ones exist.

commit.description: History of this commit (default HEAD). Any commit form

name: git_blame
